{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Metal Rabbit|kanji=辛卯|romaji=kanoto usagi|onyomi=shinbō|p=xīmǎo|w=hsin-mao|mi=ɕin⁵³ mɑʊ̯|y=san1 maau5|j=san1 maau5|ci=sɐn maːu̯|mc=sin maw|oc-bs=sin maw}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Metal Rabbit''' (辛卯, ''kanoto usagi''; onyomi ''shinbō'') is the 28th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 28th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Metal Tiger|ja|庚寅|1=Yang Metal Tiger}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Water Dragon|ja|壬辰|1=Yang Water Dragon}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''辛'' is Yin Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''卯'' (Rabbit) is Yin Wood; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Metal Rabbit (辛卯)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): xīnmǎo
** Cantonese (Jyutping): san1 maau5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoto-usagi
*** On'yomi: shinbō
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): sinmyo (신묘)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Tân Mão

==Months of Yin Metal Rabbit==
In years where the last digit is 1 or 6 (corresponding to the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} {{ill|Xin|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin}} or {{ill|Bing|ja|丙|1=Hinoe (丙)|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bing}}), the {{ill|February|en|February|qid=Q109|lt=February|1=February}} of that year is considered a Yin Metal Rabbit month. However, this applies to the {{ill|Lunisolar calendar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar calendar}}, and in some cases, the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Jingzhe|en|Jingzhe|qid=Q1306596|lt=Jingzhe|1=Jingzhe}} to the day before {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming|1=Qingming (solar term)}}) is used.

==Days of Yin Metal Rabbit==
=== Selection Days ===
Yin Metal Rabbit days are the 8th day of the {{ill|Jippōkure|ja|十方暮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jippōkure|1=Ten directions|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11405067}} cycle.
